title: Archive superseded blocked Work Items safely
outOfScope: Do not change, delete, or restate the blocked predecessor Outcome as successful.
Do not permit archive for a missing, malformed, quarantined, or unbound successor receipt.
Do not delete the predecessor checkout until its archived evidence and lifecycle closure prove cleanup is safe.

sources.reason: Current archive validation rejects a successor-bound blocked predecessor before it can preserve its red evidence.
Authoritative bound supersession evidence for the blocked predecessor that must be archived safely.
Authoritative archived successor Contract that fulfilled the predecessor correction.
Current completed successor-chain Outcome and closure evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The repair changes archival eligibility and cleanup behavior; it must preserve blocked evidence and remain fail-closed for every non-superseded receipt.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: User granted authority to complete and clean all Work Items; this Contract bounds the corrective archival behavior.

preReviewWarnings: Review that only an exact, valid superseded receipt can bypass successful-verification archival eligibility, and that the archived Outcome remains blocked.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A blocked predecessor with an exact valid superseded successor receipt can be archived without claiming its failed verification passed.
The archive transaction moves the successor receipt together with the Contract, Summary, and red Outcome.
Missing, malformed, quarantined, mismatched, or non-blocked receipts remain fail-closed.
The existing release-v0-5-54-metadata-binding predecessor can be archived and lifecycle-closed only after the new behavior is independently verified.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: A blocked release-v0-5-54-metadata-binding Work Item has a valid successor receipt pointing to an already merged and closed correction, but archive validation requires every verification to pass and therefore permanently retains obsolete dirty evidence.
constraints: Preserve the predecessor's red Outcome, failed quality evidence, and immutable release history.
Never archive a generic failed Work Item merely because a receipt file exists.
Do not delete any worktree or branch until formal lifecycle closure verifies its exact archived evidence and provider identity.
intent.rationale: A successor receipt is the governed proof that an immutable blocked delivery was replaced; allowing only that exact superseded state to archive preserves truthful history while allowing safe cleanup.

rawUserRequest: 完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。

declaredIntent.summary: Root-cause remediation and closure of a superseded blocked Work Item while preserving red evidence and performing authorized local/remote cleanup.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A blocked predecessor with its exact valid superseded receipt archives with the receipt and retains blocked Outcome status.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: archive unit regression and an actual archived predecessor closure

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing, malformed, quarantined, mismatched, or non-blocked predecessor state remains unarchivable.
The old worktree and branch remain until archive and exact lifecycle closure complete.
